Project management

  • Work plan and schedule
  • Coordination of subcontractors

01  Schedule, Budget, Quality

Planning & coordination

We manage small and mid-sized projects with clear planning, efficient coordination and full control at every stage. Every project begins with a detailed work plan setting out the activities, the deadlines, the resources and the expected costs, so that execution is organised and free of obstruction.

We coordinate the different teams: architects, engineers, contractors and suppliers: with transparent communication and respect for the schedule at every stage. We monitor progress through regular inspections, progress reporting and the quick resolution of any problem that arises.

We manage the project budget carefully, tracking actual costs against the planned estimate, and we inform clients openly about any change or additional cost. Quality assurance is a priority, every piece of work is checked against approved standards and technical specifications.

The result is projects delivered on time, within budget and to the quality expected, a calm experience for the client, from the planning stage through to final handover.

  • Detailed work plan
  • Coordination of teams and contractors
  • Reporting and quality control
